notes: Card flags the pole as broad (2.9% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) with the gate-closed regime dominating, and its max is only 0.79. The top examples are scattered tokens ('크' x6, 'ung', ' Spanish', ' platform', 'src'). Probes: '크' 0.83, ' platform' 0.71, '-ung' 0.35, ' Spanish' 0.21, plain English 0.03. The test records a token-level best guess, not a meaning.
